responsibility: Coordinates Graphviz rendering of MIR bodies and sets of MIRs, gathering the relevant MIR instances and producing DOT output with MIR-specific graph labels, styling, and per-function subgraphs.
same_name_distinction: This `graphviz.rs` is the general-purpose MIR DOT output utility, selecting MIR bodies and formatting function-level graphs and labels. The other `graphviz.rs` files are analysis-specific debug views for either NLL region constraints or solved dataflow states.
